proposals.sourceQuote: Amazon API Gateway in AWS GovCloud (US)
proposals.rationale: AWS documents Amazon API Gateway in AWS GovCloud and lists unavailable API Gateway features, so availability is proposed as Limited rather than Full.

AWS documents multiple API Gateway differences in AWS GovCloud, including unavailable portals, edge-optimized APIs, some HTTP API private integrations, and selected TLS options. Core API Gateway remains available, so the proposed lag is Moderate.

AWS documents CodePipeline in AWS GovCloud and lists unavailable source, build, test, deploy, invoke, and cross-region action features. The mapped row includes CodePipeline, so availability is proposed as Limited.

AWS documents CodePipeline differences in AWS GovCloud, including unavailable custom actions, batch-build action support, several deploy and invoke actions, and cross-region actions. Core CI/CD remains available, so the proposed lag is Moderate.
AWS documents Application Migration Service in AWS GovCloud and lists unavailable post-launch actions. Availability is therefore proposed as Limited rather than Full.

proposals.sourceQuote: The following post-launch actions are not available.
proposals.rationale: AWS documents Application Migration Service differences in AWS GovCloud, including unavailable third-party post-launch actions, App2Container replatforming, and Refactor Spaces enablement. Core rehost migration remains available, so the proposed lag is Moderate.

proposals.sourceQuote: AWS Security Hub in AWS GovCloud (US)
proposals.rationale: AWS documents Security Hub in AWS GovCloud and lists unavailable integrations, console features, plans, and related CSPM/Inspector differences. Because the mapped SIEM row includes Security Hub as a SIEM pattern, availability is proposed as Limited.

proposals.sourceQuote: Security Hub Extended Plan is not available.
proposals.rationale: AWS documents multiple Security Hub differences in AWS GovCloud, including unsupported integrations, unavailable usage/cost pages, no Extended Plan, and related CSPM/Inspector differences. Core Security Hub remains available, so the proposed lag is Moderate.

proposals.sourceQuote: Azure Monitor enables the same features
proposals.rationale: Microsoft states that Azure Monitor enables the same features in Azure and Azure Government, so the mapped Azure Monitor parity lag is proposed as None.

proposals.sourceQuote: API Management features aren't currently available
proposals.rationale: Microsoft documents API Management endpoints and a specific Azure Government feature gap for API Management. Availability is proposed as Limited rather than Full.
Microsoft lists Azure AD B2C integration as the API Management feature currently unavailable in Azure Government. Because the documented API Management gap is narrow, the proposed lag is Minor.

proposals.sourceQuote: Azure Migrate features aren't currently available
proposals.rationale: Microsoft documents Azure Migrate in Azure Government and lists unavailable containerization/deployment features plus Azure Government-only assessment target constraints. Availability is proposed as Limited.
Microsoft lists several Azure Migrate feature gaps and assessment constraints in Azure Government. Core migration assessment remains available, so the proposed lag is Moderate.
Microsoft documents Cost Management and Billing under Azure Government variations and identifies a CSP-related gap. Availability is proposed as Limited rather than Full.
Microsoft lists Cost Management and Billing for CSPs as unavailable in Azure Government. Because the documented gap is narrow, the proposed lag is Minor.

proposals.sourceQuote: Standard and Premium tiers are available
proposals.rationale: Microsoft documents Azure Front Door Standard and Premium tiers as generally available in two Azure Government regions. Because the mapped row combines Front Door and WAF and the source does not establish all-region or full-feature parity, availability is proposed as Partial.

Google lists Apigee as an Assured Workloads supported product for regulated control packages. Because this source establishes control-package support rather than commercial feature parity, availability is proposed as Partial.

Google lists Cloud Build and Cloud Deploy as Assured Workloads supported products for regulated control packages. Because this source establishes control-package support rather than commercial feature parity, availability is proposed as Partial.

Google lists Cloud CDN and Google Cloud Armor as Assured Workloads supported products for regulated control packages. Because this source establishes control-package support rather than commercial feature parity, availability is proposed as Partial.

Google lists Pub/Sub as an Assured Workloads supported product for regulated control packages. Because this source establishes control-package support rather than commercial feature parity, availability is proposed as Partial.

Google lists Organization Policy Service and Resource Manager as Assured Workloads supported products for regulated control packages. Because this source establishes control-package support rather than full blueprint parity, availability is proposed as Partial.

Google lists Cloud Interconnect and Cloud DNS as Assured Workloads supported products for regulated control packages. Because the mapped row also includes Private Service Connect, which this pass did not confirm, availability is proposed as Partial.
